high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from NASA's official Twitter account (@NASA). The tweet announces that NASA has streamed the first ultra-HD video brought to Earth via laser from deep space. The video features a tabby cat named Taters. The tweet includes the following text: "We just streamed the first ultra-HD video brought to you via laser from deep space. And it’s a video of Taters, a tabby cat. This test will pave the way for high-data-rate communications in support of the next giant leap: sending humans to Mars. go.nasa.gov/47XDYom" Below the text, there
